aperture: native 16:9; no letterbox or automatic crop
asset_schema: JSON object mapping asset IDs to repository-relative or absolute image paths; all used images must exist
states_schema: Optional object keyed by shot ID, each value a list of {offset_frame: integer, asset: asset ID}; first offset must be 0; offsets strictly increase and remain within shot
subtitle_schema: List of {line_id, shot_id, start_frame, end_frame, en, zh}; absolute 24fps half-open frame intervals; no overlap or endcard captions
audio_format: 48000 Hz stereo WAV, exactly total_frames * 2000 samples per channel; no implicit padding or truncation
endcard: Renderer-authored exact typography; final story-defined card interval only; no invented credits
composition: Source frames are aspect-contained with LANCZOS only where resizing is needed; all source pixels remain visible. Subtitle typography is composited once per static state, not rendered through a per-frame Python pipe.
cache: Static composites and frame-exact ffmpeg segments keyed by input hashes, text, frame count and renderer version; partial files never count as completed cache entries
validation: complete final video/audio decode with exact video frame count
complete unique dialogue-caption coverage with locked bilingual text
input hashes unchanged during encoding and before promotion
subtitle_layout_schema: Optional map shot ID -> {bottom_margin: integer pixels, 58–750}; default 58. Authored per-shot safe positions are recorded in subtitle_layouts.json and reviewed on actual composites.
subtitle_design: Chinese first at 40 px, English second at 32 px; approximately 96 px two-language block; restrained 2 px dark stroke, no rectangular panel. Authored per-shot safe positions clear hands and faces.
review_outputs: work/ep01/render/review/review_manifest.json and contact_*.png; real native state/caption composites; no video encoded
